findings.description: Hardcoded OpenAI Project or Legacy Secret Key detected.
findings.remediation: Store in environment variables or cloud secrets management; rotate immediately if exposed.

findings.description: Database connection URI contains hardcoded username and password.
findings.remediation: Inject database connection URI from environment variable (e.g. DATABASE_URL).

findings.matchSnippet: const sql = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + userId;
findings.description: SQL statement constructed via string concatenation instead of parameterized placeholders.
findings.remediation: Use parameterized queries ($1, ?), prepared statements, or a verified ORM query builder.

findings.ruleName: Direct Execution of Dynamic Code (Eval / Function)
findings.description: Dynamic code execution detected (eval / Function constructor). If used with LLM outputs or user input, enables arbitrary Remote Code Execution.
findings.remediation: Replace eval() with structured parser (JSON.parse), safe AST evaluators, or dedicated sandbox.

findings.description: CORS policy enables wildcard origin alongside credentials: true, exposing user sessions to cross-origin abuse.
findings.remediation: Specify explicit, trusted origins in the CORS configuration rather than wildcard or boolean true.

findings.description: Cryptographic secret falls back to a weak static string if environment variable is missing.
findings.remediation: Throw a startup configuration error if required secret environment variable is undefined.
